summary: Phase 5 Ghost Maze (boss + Stripe): Backend 23/23 pytest PASSED (14 prior + 9 new payments tests in /app/backend/tests/test_payments_api.py). Frontend: main menu / boss-level-5 / non-boss-level-4 / boss-level-10 / shop all render correctly at 375x667. Stripe flow end-to-end verified — pack_small click → real https://checkout.stripe.com/c/pay/cs_test_... URL with Starter Coin Pack / US$0.99 / 100 Ghost Coins. Boss-bar testID='boss-bar' shows '⚠️ AWAKENED · HP 3/3' on levels 5 and 10; pellets-bar is replaced (not just hidden) — only one bar visible at a time. Non-boss level 4 shows 'PELLETS: 121/126' as expected. HUD shows all 6 columns (LEVEL/SCORE/COINS/CATCHES/DOWN/LIVES) without clipping; LIVES shows 3 yellow dots. All 4 D-pads (Blinky/Pinky/Inky/Clyde) show all 4 directional arrows (▲▼◀▶). Power-up bar is single-row scrollable, PAUSE/SOUND/QUIT visible at bottom. Visually, on level 5/10 Pellet Guy sprite is noticeably larger than on level 4. A faint red/pink aura is rendered around the Pellet Guy (BossAuraSprite). Backend endpoints — GET /api/checkout/packs returns exactly the 4 expected packs with correct price_cents/coins/badges (pack_small 99/100/null, pack_medium 299/400/POPULAR, pack_large 499/1000/BEST VALUE, pack_xl 999/2500/MEGA DEAL). POST /api/checkout/session returns session_id (cs_…) + https checkout_url + correct amount/coins. GET /api/checkout/session/{id} returns status='pending', coins_granted=false before payment, and 404 for unknown ids. GET /api/checkout/player/{pid}/balance returns {coins:0} for new players and >=0 for existing. Validation: bad pack_id→400; missing pack_id→422; short player_id (len<4)→422. Existing endpoints (daily-seed, scores/leaderboard, name sanitization) all still pass. No red-screen errors on any route. Only console noise is harmless audio autoplay-blocked errors (no user gesture in headless mode) and pre-existing 'shadow*' / 'props.pointerEvents' RN-Web deprecation WARNs that have been documented in prior iterations.

minor.issue: Pre-existing from iterations 3/4: Field(max_length=16) on player_name short-circuits the sanitize_name validator's truncation branch with 422. Not Phase-5 regression; low priority.

react_native_issues.issue: Console floods with 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' and '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow"' WARNs on every screen. Likely coming from third-party components (expo-router / RN internals) rather than app code, but worth a sweep through /app/frontend (especially MazeRenderer.tsx shadow* styles on line ~721-724 and any explicit pointerEvents= props) to silence what we own. Reference: /var/log/supervisor/expo.err.log + /app/frontend/src/game/MazeRenderer.tsx:721-724

On /game routes the page emits multiple 'play() failed because the user didn't interact with the document first' page errors. These are not red-screens but pollute the console and indicate sounds.ts triggers playback (e.g. ambient/UI ping) before any user gesture. Consider gating the first play() behind first onPress or catching NotAllowedError silently. Reference: /app/frontend/src/game/sounds.ts (createAudioPlayer pool).

action_items: (Optional) Silence RN-Web deprecation warnings: replace any 'shadow*' style props (e.g. MazeRenderer.tsx BossAuraSprite at lines 721-724) with 'boxShadow' for web, and any pointerEvents={...} prop with style={{pointerEvents:'none'}}.

(Optional) Wrap audio player.play() in a try/catch that swallows DOMException 'NotAllowedError' on web, or defer first play to the first onPress/onClick. Currently the autoplay error is fired ~10x on /game route load.

(Optional, carried over) ScoreSubmission.mode Literal['classic','daily'] still excludes 'custom'; if a user finishes a custom-seed run and clicks SUBMIT SCORE, backend will 422. Either add 'custom' to the Literal (and filter from default leaderboards) or hide the submit-score-box on custom runs.
(Optional, carried over) Pre-existing player_name Field(max_length=16) vs sanitize_name truncation inconsistency.
critical_code_review_comments: BossAuraSprite (MazeRenderer.tsx:660-729) lacks a testID; if the main agent ever wants to assert aura visibility automatically, add e.g. testID='boss-aura' on the outer Animated.View. Not blocking — visually verified on level 5 and level 10.

payments.py:_fulfill_session uses upsert + status-transition filter for idempotency — correct. modified_count>0 OR upserted_id detection of credit transition is robust against concurrent poll+webhook. Good.

payments.py:create_checkout_session does NOT enforce CreateCheckoutRequest.success_origin against an allow-list; an attacker controlling player_id could request arbitrary success_origin and produce a phishing-looking Stripe page. Low risk because Stripe URL itself is fine — but consider validating origin matches preview host or EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL.

server.py:165-167 init_stripe() is called at import time, before app.include_router — fine, but logs a warning if STRIPE_API_KEY missing rather than failing fast. In production you may want a startup assertion.
boss.ts is_boss_level / isBossLevel(level): every multiple of 5 is a boss level (5,10,15,…). Confirmed both 5 and 10 trigger the boss bar.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (main menu, /game levels 4/5/10, /shop, Stripe redirect — all verified at 375x667)
